rationale_evidence.anchor: Abhava -- Ruling: both -- the requirement is universal; the taxonomy/classifier is a mechanism.
rationale_evidence.statement: Special Area B ruling: the requirement that negative/lacuna states are first-class and must not collapse into missing-data or falsity IS the Unknown != Absent != False law (C-10, STRONG EKS evidence) and is Universal; the four-fold absence classification (prior-absence, destroyed, mutual-absence, absolute-absence) and its typed classifier are a reasoning/representation mechanism organizing HOW absence is recorded, and are Deferred. Consequence: the requirement enters the Adopted Core (law 9, consolidating H-ZERO-001 + Uncertainty-001); the taxonomy is deferred.
